supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: observable 2D lateral extension beyond the outer eye orbit

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: muzzle and chin regions exhibit significantly lower pixel intensity (lighter) than the dark periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: moderate vertical thickness with distinct structural droop of the lower lip

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: pronounced raised protrusion/swelling on the right supraorbital ridge; light-colored depigmented patch on the upper cranial skin
other_distinctive_markers: distinctive bulging mass on the lateral edge of the brow ridge
